title: Fresh Shrimp Spring Rolls with Peanut Sauce
hook: Lunch that keeps you full with no food coma: fresh shrimp rolls in 25 minutes
benefit: Lean protein and crunchy vegetables, light and filling
ingredients: 16 cooked large shrimp, peeled, halved lengthwise
steps: Cover the vermicelli with boiling water for 5 minutes, drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk peanut butter, hoisin, lime juice and soy sauce, then thin with warm water until pourable.
Dip one wrapper in warm water for 10 to 15 seconds until just soft and lay it on a damp board.
On the bottom third, layer lettuce, a small bundle of noodles, carrot, cucumber and herbs. Set 4 shrimp halves pink side down just above.
Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll it up tight. Repeat for 8 rolls.
Serve with the peanut sauce. Rolls keep 1 day wrapped in a damp towel in the fridge.

title: Peanut Butter Stuffed Date Bites
hook: The 3pm candy bar craving, fixed with 5 ingredients and no baking
benefit: Fiber, potassium and healthy fats, sweetened by the dates themselves
ingredients: 1/4 cup natural peanut butter (or almond butter)
steps: Slit each date down one side, pull out the pit and open it like a book.
Spoon 1 teaspoon of peanut butter into each date and press in a few chopped peanuts.
Melt the chocolate with the coconut oil in the microwave in 20 second bursts, stirring between each.
Dip or drizzle half of each date with chocolate and finish with a tiny pinch of flaky salt.
Set on parchment and freeze for 20 minutes. Keep them in the freezer for up to a month.

title: 30-Minute Bibimbap Bowl
hook: Bibimbap at home in 30 minutes: 5 vegetables, one egg, zero takeout
benefit: A balanced plate with lean protein, whole grains and five vegetables
ingredients: 8 oz lean ground beef (or crumbled firm tofu)
steps: Brown the beef in a hot pan over medium-high for 5 to 6 minutes with the soy sauce, 1 teaspoon sesame oil, the sugar and garlic. Set aside.
In the same pan with 1 teaspoon oil, cook the mushrooms 3 minutes, then the carrots 2 minutes, then the spinach until just wilted, about 1 minute. Salt each lightly.
Blanch the bean sprouts in boiling water for 30 seconds and drain, or use them raw for crunch.
Fry the eggs in the last teaspoon of oil over medium for about 3 minutes, until the whites set and the yolks stay runny.
Divide the rice between 2 bowls, arrange the vegetables and beef in sections, top with an egg, gochujang, sesame seeds and the rest of the sesame oil. Mix it all up before eating.

title: 15-Minute Huevos Rancheros
hook: Weekend breakfast in 15 minutes that holds you until lunch: huevos rancheros
benefit: Protein from eggs and beans plus fiber from corn tortillas and avocado
ingredients: 2 tbsp crumbled queso fresco or feta
steps: Warm the beans with the cumin and 2 tablespoons of water in a small pan over medium for 3 minutes, then mash them lightly.
Warm the salsa in a small pot or in the microwave for 1 minute.
Heat 1 teaspoon of oil in a skillet over medium-high and toast the tortillas 30 seconds per side until lightly crisp. Set aside.
Add the rest of the oil and fry the eggs over medium for about 3 minutes. Cover for the last minute so the whites set and the yolks stay soft.
Stack 2 tortillas on each plate, spread on the beans, top with 2 eggs, warm salsa, avocado, cheese, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

title: West African Peanut Stew
hook: One pot, feeds 6, freezes beautifully: West African peanut stew
benefit: Plant protein and fiber from chickpeas, vitamin A from sweet potato
ingredients: 4 cups chopped kale or collard greens
Lime wedges, chopped peanuts and cilantro to serve
steps: Cook the onion in the oil over medium for 5 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, tomato paste, cumin, paprika and cayenne and stir for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, chickpeas and broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter with 1 cup of hot broth from the pot until smooth, then stir it back in.
Add the kale and simmer 10 more minutes, until the sweet potato is fork tender.
Salt to taste and finish with lime, chopped peanuts and cilantro. Serve over brown rice.

title: Sheet Pan Tandoori Chicken with Raita

title: Golden Mango Turmeric Smoothie

Pour into 2 glasses and top with a few chia seeds. Drink right away or keep in a sealed jar for the day.

title: Lighter Shrimp and Grits
hook: Shrimp and grits, lightened up: 30 minutes, big flavor, no heavy cream
benefit: Lean protein from shrimp with whole-grain stone-ground grits
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
1/4 tsp salt, plus more for the grits
1/2 cup low-sodium chicken broth (for the sauce)
steps: Bring the 2 cups broth and 2 cups water to a boil, whisk in the grits, turn to low, cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes, stirring now and then. Stir in the cheddar and black pepper.
While the grits cook, toss the shrimp with smoked paprika, garlic powder, cayenne and salt.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high. Cook the bell pepper for 3 minutes, then the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the shrimp and cook about 2 minutes per side, until pink and curled.
Pour in the 1/2 cup broth and lemon juice and simmer 1 minute to make a light sauce. Stir in the scallions and spoon over the grits.

title: One-Pan Lemon Chicken Orzo
hook: One pan, 30 minutes: lemon chicken orzo that tastes like a Greek island
benefit: Lean protein and iron-rich greens in one pan
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 cup dry orzo (whole wheat if you can find it)
2 tbsp chopped fresh dill or parsley
steps: Season the chicken with oregano, salt and pepper. Sear in 1 tablespoon oil over medium-high for 5 to 6 minutes until golden and cooked through. Remove to a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, cook the onion 3 minutes, the garlic 30 seconds, then toast the orzo for 1 minute.
Pour in the broth and lemon zest. Simmer, stirring often, for 10 to 12 minutes until the orzo is tender and creamy.
Stir in the spinach, tomatoes, lemon juice and the chicken. Cook 2 minutes until the spinach wilts.
Top with feta and dill and serve straight from the pan.

title: Smoky Baba Ganoush
hook: Thanksgiving week appetizer that is mostly vegetables: smoky baba ganoush, 7 ingredients
benefit: Fiber and healthy fats in a dip that is mostly eggplant
ingredients: 2 tbsp olive oil, plus more to finish
Cucumber, carrots, bell pepper and whole wheat pita to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 450F. Prick the eggplants all over, set them on a foil-lined sheet pan and roast 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until collapsed and charred.
Cool 10 minutes, split them open and scoop the flesh into a colander. Let it drain 10 minutes and discard the skins.
Chop the flesh fine or mash it with a fork, then stir in the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, salt and olive oil.
Spread in a bowl, drizzle with olive oil and top with parsley, smoked paprika and pomegranate seeds.
Serve with crunchy vegetables and warm pita. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.
